clue.text: Finish brilliantly in two languages

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a high-gloss coating for wooden furniture
second meaning, cryptic: the names of two European languages, one after the other

explanation.surface: Someone completes a task with flair while speaking two tongues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finish' is a noun here: a glossy coating on wood, not the act of completing something.
explanation.definitionFit: French polish is a shellac coating rubbed onto furniture to give a high-gloss surface.

clue.text: Pays for device to make leg-rest

parts.note: to foot the bill is to pay for it, so foots means pays for
a tool is a device or implement

explanation.surface: Someone buys a gadget to rest their legs on.
explanation.definitionFit: A footstool is a low stool for supporting the feet and legs while sitting.

clue.text: Blue blanket: current charge may follow this, very exciting

parts.words: Blue blanket: current charge may follow this
parts.note: each of blue, blanket, current and charge can follow the answer to make a familiar phrase

explanation.surface: A sad comforter, followed by an electricity bill.
explanation.walkthrough: The four words of the first part are not wordplay to be worked on; each can come after the answer to make a common phrase, such as a blanket that heats a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrilling atmosphere or performance is often described as charged or crackling, hence this word.

clue.text: Small role, but was offered Oscar

parts.note: something that came your way was offered to you
O is Oscar in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An actor with a bit part nonetheless gets an Academy Award nomination.
explanation.walkthrough: Oscar suggests the film award, but it is only the radio code word for the letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: A cameo is a brief appearance in a film or play, often by a well-known actor.

clue.text: Cooped up at home, a luxurious one

parts.note: pent, as in pent-up, means shut in or confined
a house is a home

explanation.surface: Someone stuck indoors, though in rather plush surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' refers back to home: the definition is a luxurious home.
explanation.definitionFit: A penthouse is an expensive flat on the top floor of a tall building, a byword for luxury living.

clue.text: Child finishing their time at school, no friend of EU

definitions.text: Child finishing their time at school
definitions.meaning: first meaning: a pupil about to leave school
second meaning: someone who voted for Britain to quit the European Union in the 2016 referendum

explanation.surface: A school-leaver turns out to be a Eurosceptic.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means anyone departing, applied both to final-year pupils and to Brexit supporters.

clue.text: Middle Easterner first to suffer actual unpleasantness dating Iraqi

indicators.note: first to applies to each following word, asking for its opening letter

explanation.surface: A Gulf resident endures awkwardness while going out with someone from Iraq.
explanation.definitionFit: A Saudi is a native of Saudi Arabia, a country in the Middle East.

clue.text: Anecdotes about British places to eat

indicators.note: about means around, so the stories go around the abbreviation

parts.note: anecdotes are tales

explanation.surface: Stories told about the restaurants of Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Tables are pieces of furniture at which people sit to have meals.

clue.text: They say he can't choose protein in pub

indicators.note: in places the protein word inside the word for a pub

parts.note: a bar is a pub
an egg is a protein food

explanation.surface: A man in a pub can't decide between protein options.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition alludes to the proverb that such people can't be choosers.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying 'beggars can't be choosers' means the needy must accept what they are given.

clue.text: A national symbol came into being

parts.note: the rose is the national flower of England

explanation.surface: A country's emblem was created.
explanation.definitionFit: Arose means emerged or appeared, i.e. began to exist.

clue.text: Model car, a true sport

parts.note: the Mini is a famous small British car

indicators.note: to sport is to play about, so these letters frolic into a new order

explanation.surface: A toy car admired by a genuine good sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sport' looks like a noun but works as the anagram signal on 'a true'.
explanation.definitionFit: Used adjectivally, a model railway or ship is a small-scale version, i.e. a miniature one.

clue.text: Country hotel, so fashionable

indicators.note: fashionable read as fashion-able, able to be fashioned into a new shape

explanation.surface: A rural hotel that is so trendy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country' looks like an adjective describing the hotel, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesotho is a small independent kingdom entirely surrounded by South Africa.

clue.text: Getting better, we're told, in hooker's job

indicators.note: we're told points to something heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: healing means recovering, getting better

explanation.surface: Recovering, apparently, while working as a prostitute.
explanation.walkthrough: A hooker here is the rugby forward in the middle of the scrum, whose task is to hook the ball back with the heel.
explanation.definitionFit: In a rugby scrum the hooker's role is to heel the ball backwards to teammates.

clue.text: Damning evidence of bad habit: one's shot

parts.note: smoking is a classic bad habit
a gun is something one shoots, i.e. a shooter

explanation.surface: Proof of a harmful vice, as one gets shot.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatically, a smoking gun is conclusive proof of guilt, like a freshly fired weapon at a crime.

clue.text: The King's home, elegance over acres

indicators.note: in a down answer, over places the first piece above the second

parts.note: grace means elegance
acres are land

explanation.surface: A royal residence where refinement matters more than size of estate.
explanation.walkthrough: The King is Elvis Presley, not a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Graceland is Elvis Presley's mansion in Memphis; Elvis is known as the King of Rock and Roll.

clue.text: An indistinct band?

parts.note: a smudged shape is a word for something indistinct, and also the name of a 1990s Britpop group

explanation.walkthrough: Band means a music group as well as a stripe; the answer is both a fuzzy shape and a well-known English band.
explanation.definitionFit: A blur is something seen only hazily; Blur is also the Britpop group fronted by Damon Albarn.

clue.text: Always set off, at any rate

indicators.note: off means out of order or wrong, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone always departs, in any case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set off' reads as departing, but 'set' is part of the anagram fodder and 'off' alone signals it.
explanation.definitionFit: Leastways is an informal word meaning at least or anyhow, used to qualify a statement.

clue.text: Party manager to bind up neck injury

parts.note: a whip is the official who keeps a political party's MPs in line
to lash is to tie tightly

explanation.surface: A party enforcer is told to bandage up a crick in the neck.
explanation.definitionFit: Whiplash is a neck injury caused by a sudden jolt, typically in a car crash.

clue.text: Large dog returning, holding this in mouth?

definitions.text: Large dog returning, holding this in mouth?

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
a lab is a Labrador, a breed of dog

explanation.surface: A big retriever comes back with something in its jaws.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue paints the scene: a dog running back with the thing it has fetched.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogs famously fetch and carry back a thrown ball in their mouths.

clue.text: Fundamental principles I start to challenge in low voice

indicators.note: in places these letters inside the word for a low voice

parts.note: bass is the lowest male singing voice

indicators.note: start to means the first letter

explanation.surface: Someone begins to contest core beliefs, speaking quietly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'low voice' suggests whispering, but it is the deep singing range.
explanation.definitionFit: The basics are the essential elements or foundations of a subject.

clue.text: Be given a red card? Show mercy

definitions.meaning: first meaning, cryptic: to hold a card of the red suit hearts
second meaning: the idiom asking someone to be compassionate

explanation.walkthrough: A red card suggests a football sending-off, but here it is a playing card from the hearts suit.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Have a heart!' is an idiomatic plea for kindness or leniency.

clue.text: Shoot ploughman

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a shoot growing from the base of a plant
second meaning: one who tills the soil

explanation.walkthrough: 'Shoot' looks like a verb, but it is a plant's sprout.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiller is both a sprouting stem from a grass's base and a farmer who cultivates land.

clue.text: Celebration: is it safe to dance?

indicators.note: letters that dance move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A partygoer wonders whether the dancefloor is safe.
explanation.walkthrough: Only 'it safe' is the fodder; 'is' is a link word, though it looks part of the question.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiesta is a festival or holiday, especially in Spanish-speaking countries.

clue.text: Realist waving flag

indicators.note: waving means moving back and forth, so the letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: A pragmatic person flaps a banner.
explanation.definitionFit: The saltire is the diagonal-cross flag of Scotland, the St Andrew's Cross.

clue.text: Grub, a scoop from popular vanilla

indicators.note: a scoop takes out a portion from within these words

explanation.surface: Food: a portion of everyone's favourite ice cream flavour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grub' suggests food, which fits the ice cream, but it is an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: A larva is the immature wormlike stage of an insect, commonly called a grub.

clue.text: As written, I must be punishable by death

definitions.meaning: first meaning, cryptic: the pronoun I is always written as an upper-case letter
second meaning: a ... crime carries the death penalty

explanation.surface: A condemned person writes about their fate.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital describes an uppercase letter and also an offence carrying execution as its penalty.

clue.text: Cold spring month, almost all in upmarket resort

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

indicators.note: almost all means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: April is a month in spring

explanation.surface: A chilly spring in a fashionable holiday spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an Italian island in the Bay of Naples, long a glamorous holiday destination.

clue.text: Witty person alert for cheat

parts.note: a card is an amusing, eccentric person
sharp means alert, quick-witted

explanation.surface: A quick-witted joker is on the lookout for a swindler.
explanation.definitionFit: A cardsharp is a professional swindler at card games.

clue.text: Conscious of a solemn vigil

parts.note: a wake is a watch kept over a dead body before burial

explanation.surface: Someone aware of a mournful all-night watch.
explanation.definitionFit: Being awake means not asleep, alert and aware.

clue.text: Flashers risk lenient sentence at first

parts.note: a hazard is a risk
a light sentence is a lenient one

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter is taken

explanation.surface: Indecent exposers risk a soft punishment from the court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flashers' suggests indecent exposure, but it means blinking lights.
explanation.definitionFit: Hazard lights are a car's indicators blinking together to warn other drivers of danger.
